description: This file declares the ServerManagerModuleService class and its factory, which are part of the IPC (Inter-Process Communication) layer for managing server modules in the Rialto project. It defines interfaces for setting configuration, state, log levels, and ping operations, and references external classes and protobuf messages.

classes.name: ServerManagerModuleServiceFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating instances of ServerManagerModuleService, implementing the IServerManagerModuleServiceFactory interface.

classes.name: ServerManagerModuleService
classes.description: Implementation of the ServerManagerModule service, providing methods to set configuration, state, log levels, and handle ping requests, inheriting from the protobuf-generated ServerManagerModule.

methods.name: ServerManagerModuleServiceFactory
methods.description: Default constructor for the factory class.

methods.name: ~ServerManagerModuleServiceFactory
methods.description: Default destructor for the factory class.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates and returns a shared pointer to a ServerManagerModule, given a session server manager reference.

methods.name: ServerManagerModuleService
methods.description: Constructor initializing the service with a session server manager reference.

methods.name: setConfiguration
methods.description: Handles setting configuration via protobuf RPC.

methods.name: setState
methods.description: Handles setting state via protobuf RPC.

methods.name: setLogLevels
methods.description: Handles setting log levels via protobuf RPC.

methods.name: ping
methods.description: Handles ping requests to check service responsiveness.
